claim_text: Teaching on refusing fear thoughts by keeping a high level of scripture, offered as method rather than as a forward claim.
quote: we're a work in progress just like everybody else
falsify_match: Nothing external can confirm it; it is advice about his own practice.
falsify_miss: Nothing external can refute it either, which is why it carries no forward cue.

claim_text: The UN meeting in September 2025 will make or break the financial structure of America, and within a 24 hour period everything known will change.
quote: what's going to come in September is a time to remember
falsify_match: A single day in September 2025 in which the American financial structure is visibly and irreversibly altered, tied to a UN decision.
falsify_miss: September 2025 passes with the UN General Assembly proceeding and American financial arrangements unchanged. Base rate: UN high-level week happens every September and is never financially decisive.

claim_text: Rioting and looting across the world during this period, far beyond the 2020 BLM unrest, alongside a great financial outpouring as America lines up with Israel.
quote: It is across the world. people are acting a fool and burning
falsify_match: Simultaneous riots in many countries at a scale measurably above the 2020 wave, in 2025 or 2026.
falsify_miss: No global riot wave in that window. Base rate: unrest somewhere is constant, so only the worse-than-2020 comparison makes this scoreable.

claim_text: Netanyahu is seen in the eye of a hurricane with voices around it saying he must be removed and repeating war crimes; separately Trump is seen roughly fifty pounds lighter in the days ahead.
quote: they were wanting to remove him. He has to be removed
falsify_match: Netanyahu leaves office or faces a formal war crimes proceeding while under visible pressure to go.
falsify_miss: He remains in office with no removal push of that kind. Base rate: the ICC had already sought his arrest in November 2024, so calls to remove him predate the vision.

claim_text: The American battleships around Venezuela are not about drug trafficking but about stalling BRICS, which is offering Venezuela, Cuba and North Korea relief from sanctions in exchange for oil.
quote: this is more than drug trafficking. He's trying to cause a front
falsify_match: Documentation or admission that the Caribbean deployment was aimed at BRICS oil arrangements rather than narcotics.
falsify_miss: The deployment stays framed and operated as counter-narcotics. This is a motive claim about a real deployment already in the news, so it reads onto known facts rather than predicting them.

claim_text: Canada goes through a great financial shaking and joins America financially, keeping its physical border but losing its separate currency, becoming a 51st state in money only.
quote: They joined with us financially and they become the 51st state financially
falsify_match: Canada abandons the Canadian dollar for a shared currency with the United States while remaining a separate country.
falsify_miss: The Canadian dollar continues. Base rate: no G7 country has ever surrendered its currency to a neighbour outside the euro project.

claim_text: Mexico, Australia and Europe join the same currency bloc with America to counter BRICS, while the German chancellor is seen looking both ways, undecided between the two.
quote: he was looking at America and he was looking at the bricks
falsify_match: A formal currency or financial bloc containing America, Mexico, Australia and Europe, with Germany publicly wavering toward BRICS.
falsify_miss: No such bloc forms and Germany stays in the euro and in NATO alignment without a BRICS approach.

claim_text: Two major buildings in America explode from the inside out on their upper floors, which he distinguishes from how the 9/11 towers fell.
quote: Two major buildings in America that were exploding on the top
falsify_match: Two American high-rise buildings suffer upper-floor explosions originating inside them.
falsify_miss: No such event. He does not name a city here, which is looser than the earlier telling that placed it in New York.

claim_text: A major earthquake in British Columbia again, and the February 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy singled out as something serious to pray over.
quote: he highlighted the Olympics in February and it's in Italy
falsify_match: A serious incident at or around the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics in February 2026, beyond ordinary sporting controversy.
falsify_miss: The Winter Olympics run without a major incident. He states no content for the Olympics warning, only that it is serious, which limits what can be scored.

claim_text: The prosperity Trump is excited about is built on a thin foundation and is a short window to fill pockets rather than a lasting recovery.
quote: notice the foundation is really thin there
falsify_match: A visible boom followed by a sharp reversal within the period he describes.
falsify_miss: Sustained growth without the reversal. The claim is hedged both ways, since a boom confirms the pockets and a bust confirms the thin foundation.

claim_text: He reasons the rapture falls near 2028 by counting seven year shmita cycles from Israel becoming a nation in 1948, with a generation running to eighty or a hundred and twenty years.
quote: going from 1948 to 2028 would be the end of the schmeita cycle
falsify_match: The rapture occurs in 2028.
falsify_miss: 2028 passes without it. He labels this his own reckoning rather than something he was told, which is worth keeping separate from the visions.

claim_text: Three Democratic voices seen rising: the California governor, Kamala Harris, and a Black senator who has run for president before whose voice grows louder in the days ahead.
quote: his voice became louder in the days ahead
falsify_match: Cory Booker becomes a markedly more prominent national voice than he was in August 2025.
falsify_miss: He stays at the same level of prominence. He does not remember the name with confidence, which weakens the identification.

claim_text: The California governor knowingly turned his back on people being trafficked across the border, and demonic things tied to this will be uncovered and lead to his removal.
quote: I saw him turning his back to it like he knew
falsify_match: A trafficking scandal implicating the governor personally, followed by his removal from office.
falsify_miss: No such scandal and he completes his term. This is an accusation against a named living person offered on the vision alone.

claim_text: Looking into 2027 and 2028 he saw the United States not existing as it does now, with Texas seceded behind thick east and west walls and Oklahoma split on a line from Miami to Altus.
quote: the United States of America, I'm going to say this, didn't exist
falsify_match: American territorial breakup by the end of 2028, with Texas out of the union.
falsify_miss: The union is intact through 2028. He attaches the prayer condition here, which he can invoke either way.

claim_text: Urgency over the presidents health and safety framed as more than praying against a heart attack, with most people not surviving what is coming for those left in the tribulation.
quote: most people will not there a lot of people
falsify_match: A serious health or security incident affecting the president.
falsify_miss: No such incident. The tribulation half of the statement is not checkable within any period.

claim_text: A great shaking and then a major revival in Canada, with British Columbia turning red after the earthquake, seceding from Canada and joining America, and a coastal highway formed up to Alaska.
quote: they turned red and and and they seceded from Canada
falsify_match: British Columbia moves to leave Canada following a major earthquake, with a road link to Alaska under American control.
falsify_miss: No secession movement of that kind. Base rate: Quebec, not BC, is where Canadian secession sentiment has actually been measurable.

claim_text: The Federal Reserve chair holds rates down out of loyalty to Democrats and men in suits, delaying the inevitable, and a new digital dollar is coming.
quote: he wanted to appease the Democrats because he was he was in their pocket
falsify_match: Evidence that rate decisions were driven by partisan loyalty, and a digital dollar issued.
falsify_miss: Rate decisions track inflation and employment data, and no digital dollar is issued. The Fed cut rates on 17 September 2025, two weeks after this, which cuts against the refusal he describes.

claim_text: Inflation is worse than the published figures and the economy is being kept afloat artificially.
quote: are worse than what they're saying. They're keeping it afloat
falsify_match: A revision or audit showing official inflation understated the real figure.
falsify_miss: CPI revisions stay within normal bounds. Base rate: the claim that official inflation understates reality is a permanent feature of this genre and costs nothing to make.

claim_text: A disclaimer that he gives no financial advice, does not confirm or contradict other prophetic voices, and that listeners are accountable for their own decisions.
quote: I am not a financial adviser. Never will be
falsify_match: Not applicable; this is a standing disclaimer.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it is worth recording because it sits directly beside the wealth transfer material.

claim_text: Prayer over livestock, ground and finances, asking that the curse of the screwworm on cattle be lifted as America blesses Israel.
quote: Every curse over our cattle with these worms
falsify_match: Not applicable; this is a petition rather than a claim.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. The screwworm outbreak in Mexican cattle was current news at the time.

claim_text: Corruption in finances inside the global church will be exposed like Ananias and Sapphira, with a great shaking of the church going into the fall and into 2026, elders going home and a younger generation raised up.
quote: There's corruption in finances. There will be expos
time_phrase: going into the fall, going into 26
falsify_match: A run of major financial scandals across large ministries in several countries between autumn 2025 and the end of 2026.
falsify_miss: No such run beyond the usual rate. Base rate: ministry finance scandals surface several times a year, so only an unusual cluster would count.

claim_text: He reads a UK body storage tender for up to 700 fatalities as governments preparing for the virus he was shown, in which 350 million people die.
quote: I saw 350 million people go home
falsify_match: A pandemic killing on the order of 350 million people.
falsify_miss: No such pandemic. The tender he cites is routine local-authority contingency contracting and does not indicate foreknowledge of anything.

claim_text: He scales the 350 million figure by noting it is roughly the population of the United States, so it would be like driving coast to coast and seeing nobody.
quote: if you drove from coast to coast and you didn't see one single person
falsify_match: Deaths of that magnitude from a single virus.
falsify_miss: No event within two orders of magnitude. The 1918 influenza pandemic, the worst on record, killed an estimated 50 million.

claim_text: He was told to prepare because the British Columbia earthquake is coming and 30,000 people in that area will die.
quote: prepare this earthquake's coming 30,000 people will go home
falsify_match: An earthquake in or off British Columbia killing on the order of 30,000 people.
falsify_miss: No such earthquake, or one with a death toll far below that. Base rate: the 1700 Cascadia rupture is the last event of that class, and the region is sparsely populated compared with the tolls he names.

claim_text: Underground towns built as arks for survival, the poles shifting so the earth reels, and September named as the month to remember when earthquakes fall on the nations that do not stand with Israel.
quote: I saw underground towns in America that were like like arcs
falsify_match: Major earthquakes in September or October 2025 concentrated in countries that moved against Israel.
falsify_miss: Earthquakes in that window distributed along the usual fault lines with no relation to Israel policy. Base rate: roughly fifteen magnitude 7 events occur worldwide each year, so some will always fall in any two month window.

claim_text: North Korea, China and Russia are in secret meetings on how to overcome western culture and are becoming one like a covenant, with North Korea promised a great deal to make it confident.
quote: whispering whispers of how to overcome the western culture
falsify_match: A formal or disclosed tripartite pact beyond the existing bilateral treaties.
falsify_miss: Relations stay bilateral. This was said the week Kim Jong-un travelled to Beijing for the 3 September parade with Putin present, which was announced beforehand.

claim_text: Kim Jong-un will eventually be removed, and his sister with him; North Korea is waiting rather than bluffing, and Russia is promising it a better tomorrow in exchange for troops.
quote: Eventually, I believe Kim Jong will be removed and his sister
falsify_match: Kim Jong-un ceases to lead North Korea and Kim Yo-jong is also removed.
falsify_miss: He remains in power. He marks this one as his own belief rather than something he was shown, and gives no window, so it can never expire.

claim_text: Putin seen holding five cards fanned out and hiding behind them, with the words World War III in black letters seen before it.
quote: he had a five cards in his hand and he was holding them out
falsify_match: Five concealed Russian capabilities or moves revealed in sequence, which would give the number content.
falsify_miss: The number five never attaches to anything. He does not say what the five cards are, so the detail that looks specific carries no test.

claim_text: Channel plans for a German language stream and a new Hindi channel, with subscriber counts given.
quote: Braden he started a Hindi channel so he's working on the Hindi channel
falsify_match: Not applicable; this is channel business.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it records the reach he claims at this date.

claim_text: Surprise October 7th style attacks against Israel in the middle of the night as Gaza is taken, with Turkey involved and soldiers marching in red hats, and the fifty gallon drums recalled.
quote: There will be surprise attacks
falsify_match: A night attack on Israel of October 7th character, with Turkish forces or Turkish-backed troops involved.
falsify_miss: No such attack and Turkey stays out militarily. He notes Israel struck Damascus the same afternoon, which is the strike he treats as confirmation, but Israel had been striking Syria repeatedly through 2025.
